answer: A work-history gate resists Sybils: a new agent starts with no influence and earns it only by completing verified useful tasks over weeks, each result bound to the same identity. One task proves little, but a long coherent record, a sonnet built line by line, is costly to forge at scale. Rewards vest slowly, like saffron gathered stigma by stigma, so a flood of fresh fakes gains almost nothing, while an idle identity decays into a relic with no weight.
